verdict.rationale: Clerky documents entering information into provided fields to customize key terms of legal paperwork, which its forms then turn into documents (its Partner API forms carry a json_schema describing the data to collect), and founders can loop in an attorney to review and comment on what they enter. There is no evidence that the software itself flags specific choices as needing attorney review; review is a manual invitation. Missing for 10: automatic flagging of choices that need attorney review, explicit documentation of a guided step-by-step questionnaire with validation for correctness, and independent hands-on corroboration of the questionnaire flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can answer guided questionnaires that fill in legal documents correctly and flag choices that need attorney review

citations.quote: Our software makes it easy to customize the key terms of the legal paperwork you're working on.
you can easily loop in your attorney to have them review and comment on the information you're entering.
If you need to customize documents beyond the provided fields, you can swap out the underlying forms for any of our products.
